content: Changelog - September 2016 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093655 New Features: Member features Reset Functionality, click here for more documentation. Text Labels: removed_logo_label, profile_photo_upload_success_message, legacy_crop_message_label, deleted_photo_label For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
